description_en: Submits a video rendering and compositing job
description_zh: 提交视频渲染合成任务
name: GetVideoRenderJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the job returned by SubmitVideoRenderJob
parameters.name: job_id

Job.description_en: The video rendering and compositing node object
Job.description_zh: 视频渲染合成任务对象

EditingProjectId.description_en: The ID of the online editing project, which can be used for secondary editing of the produced video
EditingProjectId.description_zh: 在线剪辑工程 ID，可用于成片的二次编辑

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned when the job status is Failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，Failed 状态下返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. This parameter is of the String type and is returned when the job status is Failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: ErrorMessage，错误信息，String 类型，Failed 状态下返回
ErrorMessage.example: The specified product does not exist.

JobId.description_en: The ID of the job returned by SubmitVideoRenderJob

Language.description_en: The voiceover language of the produced video

Result.description_en: The download URL of the rendered and composited video
Result.description_zh: 渲染合成完成的视频下载地址

Status.description_en: The status of the job. Valid values: Created, Executing, Finished, and Failed. RecordNotFound is returned if the queried job is deleted, does not exist, or does not belong to the current account
Status.description_zh: 任务状态：Created（已创建）、Executing（执行中）、Finished（已完成）、Failed（已失败）。已删除、不存在或不属于当前账号的任务查询返回 RecordNotFound

UserData.description_en: The custom user data in JSON format
UserData.description_zh: 用户自定义参数，JSON 格式字符串
